headline: A tour-like move overall — posture through the strike is the note.

sections.title: What lined up well
sections.body: Your rotation numbers read like the reference set: shoulder turn at the top (55.2°), X-factor (24.8°), hip rotation at impact (19.4°) and spine tilt at address (29.1°) all fall inside the tour band, and your lateral weight shift (1.1%) is right where most tour swings measure.

sections.title: The main thing that stood out
sections.body: Your spine angle changed 11.2° between address and impact, just past the typical 2–10° tour range — the numbers show you standing up slightly through the strike.

sections.title: Also worth a look
sections.body: Your tempo measured 3.08 : 1, a touch quicker than the 3.1–3.7 band most tour swings show.

sections.title: One we left out
sections.body: Lead-arm extension measured 118.9°, but from down-the-line the camera can't see wrist depth reliably, so we treat it as low-confidence and left it out of the read.
